marketImplications.side: Do not treat Cubs as a plain full-game ML. Price the starter window, bridge, and conversion risk separately.
marketImplications.first5: First-five may be cleaner than full game if the starter-window edge is on the pick and the late edge flips.
marketImplications.total: Totals need chaos-gate respect; raw run projection is not enough when one-bad-inning or warm-carry risk is live.
marketImplications.firstInning: YRFI is the timing lane to compare against the side; modeled chance 50.4% YRFI.

rfLens.trustedUse: Use RF as a nonlinear totals/game-shape check first. Do not let it pick ML/F5 by itself yet.
rfLens.totalsRead: RF totals baseline supports treating the raw total as shape-sensitive, not automatic.
rfLens.moneylineRead: RF moneyline history is not deployable; it can only flag disagreement for review.
rfLens.first5Read: RF first-five history is not deployable; use it as a timing warning, not a pick.
